subject: Payment terms request: Pilot onboarding, deposit and conditional Net45
messages:
From: Sofia Ramos <sofia.ramos@medtrix.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Payment terms request: Pilot onboarding, deposit and conditional Net45

Hi Marcus,

Thanks for the time yesterday. We're excited to get the pilot with Redwood started — tech looks solid and we want to move quickly. Procurement asked me to outline payment expectations up front so they can route approvals:

- Pilot scope: 3-week integration, then 6 weeks of live telemetry
- Estimated spend (pilot): ~$60k over 90 days
- Preferred commercial: Net60 for invoices (their standard)

MedTrix has a global procurement policy that favors Net60 for new vendors, but I know Redwood typically offers Net30/45. From a cashflow perspective we can do an upfront partial payment if necessary. A few asks from procurement and tax:

1) Can you offer a conditional Net45 for the pilot if we put down a deposit (we're thinking 15-25%)?
2) We have EU subsidiaries; will you need VAT reg docs for EU invoices or can we be invoiced to our US entity?
3) Can you propose a short credit cap for the pilot (so we don't need to go through a full credit review)?

Attached is our draft PO (PO_1234.pdf) with the requested line items. If you can send a concise payment schedule and sample SOW we can route for signatures.

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick call if helpful.

Best,
Sofia Ramos
Head of Procurement, MedTrix AI
sofia.ramos@medtrix.ai
+1 415-555-0132

Attachment: PO_1234.pdf (PDF, 64 KB)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Ramos <sofia.ramos@medtrix.ai>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Lauren Bennett <lauren.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Payment terms request: Pilot onboarding, deposit and conditional Net45

Hi Sofia — great to hear and thanks for the PO. Looping in Kimberly (Finance) and Lauren (Onboarding) to make this transactional.

Short answer: we can structure a conditional Net45 for the pilot with an upfront deposit and a provisional credit cap. Proposal below to keep approvals light and get you running this month:

- Deposit: 15% of pilot estimate invoiced at signature (applies as credit to final invoice)
- Remaining: 85% billed on completion of the pilot milestone, payment Net45 from invoice date
- Provisional credit cap: $75,000 for pilot period (90 days) — no full credit application required unless you exceed that cap
- VAT/tax: For EU-billed work we require VAT registration certificate or reverse-charge confirmation; if you prefer invoicing to your US entity we can do so but we will need the US billing entity name and EIN on the PO

Attachments: I am attaching a short SOW and a payment-schedule template so your procurement team has clear line items and due dates. If MedTrix signs the SOW + PO, we will issue the deposit invoice immediately (due on receipt).

Operational notes and next steps:
- Please confirm which entity to invoice (US parent or EU subsidiary) and upload any VAT evidence to the link below.
- If deposit amount ok, reply with approved PO number and sign the attached SOW (we can DocuSign).
- Kimberly will issue the deposit invoice once we have the signed SOW + PO.

DocuSign (SOW): https://docusign.com/envelope/XYZ-456
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/contact/987654321

If your procurement needs a 25% deposit instead of 15%, we can accommodate with a slightly adjusted milestone schedule — let us know.

Thanks,
Marcus
Head of Commercial Ops, Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com
Attachment: Redwood-SOW-MedTrix-pilot.pdf (PDF, 28 KB)
Attachment: payment-schedule-template.xlsx (XLSX, 12 KB)

From: Carlos Mendes <carlos.mendes@medtrix.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Sofia Ramos <sofia.ramos@medtrix.ai>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 08:34:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Payment terms request: Pilot onboarding, deposit and conditional Net45

Marcus / Sofia —

Thanks for the quick turn. Procurement reviewed Marcus's proposal. A few follow-ups from our side:

1) Deposit: procurement wants to limit upfront exposure. Would Redwood accept 15% upfront + 10% held on acceptance (i.e., 25% total, 15% due at signing, 10% invoiced at acceptance and payable Net30)?
2) Credit cap: $75k provisional is fine for the initial 90 days. If we exceed, we'll need a short escalation window (7 business days) to submit additional financials.
3) VAT: we'll invoice from our US entity for this pilot (MedTrix Inc., EIN 12-3456789). For future EU billing we'll provide VAT certs.

Procurement also asked for a short reference of a prior customer Redwood has done a pilot with similar terms. Can Kimberly loop in a reference or point to a case study?

If we can get a 15% + 10% acceptance structure and the SOW adjusted to show the acceptance milestone, I can route for signatures today.

Thanks,
Carlos Mendes
Finance Programs, MedTrix AI
Attachment: none

Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Lauren Bennett <lauren.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 27 Nov 2026 15:40:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Payment terms request: Pilot onboarding, deposit and conditional Net45

Carlos / Sofia — appreciate the quick turn. We can accept the 15% at signing + 10% on acceptance structure with the following guardrails:

- Payment schedule:
  • Deposit invoice (15%) issued on SOW + PO signature, due on receipt
  • Acceptance invoice (10%) issued on pilot acceptance milestone, Net30
  • Final invoice (remaining 75%) issued at the end of the 90-day pilot period, Net45

- Credit cap and ramp: provisional cap of $75,000 until 2027-01-15. If usage approaches the cap we will open a 7-business-day review window for supporting docs; if approved we will lift to $150k for the full contract period.

- VAT/tax: since you confirmed MedTrix Inc. (US) as the billing entity we will invoice the US entity. For EU invoicing later we will require VAT reg documentation or a reverse-charge declaration. Please send any VAT evidence to accounting@redwood.com or upload to the secure link in the Doc above.

- References: Kimberly — can you provide a single pilot reference (anonymous financial contact) or point to a short case study we can share with procurement?

Next actions:
1) Marcus / Lauren: send updated SOW with the acceptance milestone and the three-line payment schedule (attached)
2) Sofia / Carlos: return signed SOW + PO (we can accept e-sig)
3) Kimberly: issue deposit invoice on receipt of signed SOW + PO

Thanks all — looking forward to getting this started.

Marcus Lin
